decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Heritage Statement (statement of significance and impact assessment) produced by Babatunde Dawodu dated 25 March 2017 and received on 29/11/2017

Cranford Lock-up summary of completed conservation works, produced by Taylor Pearce Limited, dated 05/02/2018 [Received on 06/02/2018].
Technical Data Sheet, produced by Keim Mineral Paints Ltd, [Received on 06/02/2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
